faq.q: What is a Seabob and is it safe for children?
faq.a: A Seabob is a motorised underwater scooter that glides just below the surface, letting you swim like a dolphin. It's safe for children aged 8 and above when used under adult supervision and with a life jacket. Our licensed skipper will give a full safety briefing before you start, and you can adjust the speed to suit your confidence.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the family Seabob combo?
faq.a: For the family Seabob combo, we recommend our Tier A boats: the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 passengers) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 passengers). Both depart from Puerto Banús and come with a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included. If you have a larger group, contact us via WhatsApp for other options.

faq.q: How much does a family boat day with Seabob cost?
faq.a: A 2-hour charter on a Tier A boat costs €749, and an 8-hour full-day charter costs €2,299. This includes the skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA. Seabob rental is priced on request – message us on WhatsApp for a quote.

faq.q: Do we need boating experience to use a Seabob?
faq.a: No boating experience is required. Our skipper handles the boat, and you'll receive a quick Seabob tutorial before entering the water. The Seabob is intuitive to control, with a simple trigger to accelerate and a handlebar to steer. We'll also provide life jackets and recommend calm spots like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for the best experience.

faq.q: What should we bring for the Seabob part of the day?
faq.a: Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen (reef-safe preferred), and a light cover-up. Sunglasses with a strap are handy. We provide water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks on board. If you have a GoPro or underwater camera, bring it – the Seabob experience is highly Instagrammable.

faq.q: Can we combine Seabob with other activities like snorkelling?
faq.a: Absolutely. The Seabob is perfect for exploring coves and rocky inlets, and you can easily switch to snorkelling in the same spots. Popular stops include Cabopino, Cala del Faro, and Cala Cortés, where the water is calm and clear. Our skipper will tailor the route to your family's preferences.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for a family boat day?
faq.a: We understand plans change. For cancellations made more than 48 hours before departure, we offer a full refund. Within 48 hours, a 50% refund applies. If we cancel due to unsafe weather conditions, you receive a 100% refund or the option to reschedule. Contact us via WhatsApp for details.

data.body_html:
Looking for a family boat day with Seabob in Marbella? This combo gives you the best of both worlds: a private charter from Puerto Banús and the thrill of gliding underwater on a Seabob. With a licensed skipper, drinks, snacks, and insurance included, you just show up and enjoy. Choose a 2-hour taster or an 8-hour full-day adventure – both on our Tier A boats, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39.

Why Combine a Boat Charter with a Seabob?

A Seabob turns a standard boat trip into an unforgettable family experience. Instead of just swimming, kids and adults can zoom through the water like marine biologists on a mission. The Seabob is easy to control, safe with a life jacket, and works brilliantly in the calm coves around Marbella. You get the freedom of a private boat with the excitement of a water toy – without the hassle of renting separately.

Our Tier A Boats for the Family Seabob Combo

We use two boats for this experience, both departing from Puerto Banús:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, up to 9 passengers. Spacious deck, comfortable seating, and a swim platform that makes Seabob entry easy.
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, up to 11 passengers. A stylish flybridge with plenty of shade and a large bathing ladder.

Both include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA. For larger groups, contact us via WhatsApp for other options.

Pricing and Booking

Our Tier A pricing is simple:

DurationPrice (€)Inclusions
2 hours€749Skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, IVA
8 hours€2,299Skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, IVA

Seabob rental is priced on request – just message us on WhatsApp for a quote. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance to secure your preferred time.

What a Typical Family Day Looks Like

Your day starts at Puerto Banús, where you'll meet your skipper and get a safety briefing. Head out towards Cabopino or the Marbella coastline, depending on wind and sea conditions. Anchor in a calm cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where the water is clear and sheltered. Then it's time for the Seabob – the skipper will show you how to dive, turn, and surface. Alternate Seabob sessions with swimming, snorkelling, and simply lounging on deck. On an 8-hour charter, you can also stop for lunch at a chiringuito or enjoy the onboard snacks.

Safety First: Seabob with Kids

We take safety seriously. Children aged 8 and above can use the Seabob under adult supervision. Life jackets are provided, and the skipper will adjust the Seabob's speed to match the user's confidence. We always operate in calm, shallow areas for beginners. The boat's swim platform and ladder make getting in and out easy, so even less confident swimmers can join in.

Best Spots for Seabob in Marbella

The coastline between Marbella and Estepona is ideal for Seabob. Favourite spots include:

  • Cabopino – sandy coves and clear water, sheltered from the wind.
  • Cala del Faro – a rocky inlet near the lighthouse, teeming with small fish.
  • Cala Cortés – a quiet bay with crystal-clear water, perfect for beginners.
  • Río Verde – a scenic stretch near the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha.

Your skipper will choose the best spot based on conditions and your family's experience level.

Book Your Family Boat Day with Seabob

Ready to make memories? Reserve your Marbella boat charter today. For the Seabob combo, mention it when you book. We'll confirm availability and send you a WhatsApp link for payment. Prefer a different boat? Explore our full fleet or check out other experiences like sunset cruises or jet ski adventures. For any questions, our team is on WhatsApp – we typically reply within minutes.
